name: mcp-server-aact
description: Query the AACT (ClinicalTrials.gov) database directly from Claude. Explore 70+ tables of clinical trial data — studies, interventions, outcomes, sponsors, facilities — using read-only SQL with buffered pagination. All tables join on nct_id.

tools.name: database_info
tools.description: Confirm database connection, server time, and data currency

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Discover all available tables with approximate row counts

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Inspect column names, types, distinct counts, and sample values for a table

tools.name: get_column_values
tools.description: Get distinct values for a column with counts — essential before filtering

tools.name: search_columns
tools.description: Find columns by keyword across all tables (e.g. 'masking' -> designs.masking)

tools.name: read_query
tools.description: Execute a SELECT, CTE, or EXPLAIN query with buffered results and preview

tools.name: fetch_rows
tools.description: Page through buffered query results without re-querying

db_user.title: AACT Database Username
db_user.description: Required credential DB_USER. Your AACT username. Register free at https://aact.ctti-clinicaltrials.org

db_password.title: AACT Database Password
db_password.description: Required credential DB_PASSWORD. Your AACT password. Stored by the client and sent only to the AACT database.
